CHEERS.FAN #1 | Founding Infrastructure Engineers | Bay Area Preferred | U.S. Remote Considered

CHEERS.FAN #1 is an early-stage company exploring infrastructure challenges involving real-time coordination, distributed systems, and large-scale interactive experiences.

We are currently evaluating founding engineers in three areas:

1. Distributed Systems & Platform Engineering

Building reliable, scalable systems involving distributed coordination, event-driven architectures, cloud infrastructure, networking, and high-concurrency platforms.

Relevant experience may include Go, Rust, Kafka, NATS, Kubernetes, Redis, AWS, WebRTC, or related infrastructure technologies.

2. Real-Time Synchronization & Timing Systems

Building systems where timing accuracy, synchronization, low-latency communication, deterministic behavior, and real-time coordination matter.

Relevant experience may include PTP, IEEE 1588, TSN, distributed synchronization, networking, embedded networking, or performance-sensitive systems.

3. Edge & Embedded Infrastructure Engineering

Building infrastructure operating close to hardware, networking, operating systems, wireless systems, and performance-sensitive environments.

Relevant experience may include embedded Linux, device networking, wireless systems, edge computing, telecommunications infrastructure, networking platforms, or embedded systems development.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems involving scale, performance, resilience, reliability, synchronization, networking, and distributed coordination.

Candidates located in the United States are preferred.

If this sounds interesting, we'd welcome a conversation.

Eastman Russell Founder & CEO, CHEERS.FAN #1

Contact: Eastman@VBCheers.com
